settings.name: Himalayan Flames House of Momo
settings.tagline: Authentic Momos. Bold Flavours. Himalayan Soul.
settings.description: Located in Bapunagar, Ahmedabad, Himalayan Flames House of Momo brings you authentic mountain culinary traditions. From steaming hot Kathmandu Jhol Momos and ultra-crisp Kurkure Cheese Momos to fiery wok-tossed Asian street delights, we prepare every dish fresh with uncompromised hygiene and bold Himalayan spices.
settings.address: Lal Bahadur Shastri Rd, below Sankalp Restaurant, opposite Kankadiya Hospital, Shaktidhara Society, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380024
settings.landmark: Below Sankalp Restaurant, Opposite Kankadiya Hospital

menuItems.name: Classic Steamed Veg Momo
menuItems.description: Handcrafted dumplings filled with finely shredded cabbage, carrots, spring onions, and Himalayan spices. Served with fiery red chilli dip.

menuItems.name: Steamed Mountain Paneer Momo
menuItems.description: Soft cottage cheese infused with black pepper, coriander and ginger in tender thin-skin momo dough. Juicy and aromatic.

menuItems.name: Golden Fried Veg Momo
menuItems.description: Crisp golden fried dumplings with juicy vegetable stuffing, tossed in light aromatic herbs. Served with cooling mayo and hot red sauce.

menuItems.name: Himalayan Jhol Veg Momo
menuItems.description: Signature Kathmandu style steamed momos submerged in hot, sour and nutty sesame-soybean tomato broth with roasted cumin.

menuItems.name: Paneer Jhol Momo Bowl
menuItems.description: Rich paneer dumplings drenched in rich aromatic Himalayan jhol soup garnished with fresh coriander, spring onion and lemon zest.

menuItems.name: Signature Kurkure Cheese Momo
menuItems.description: Coated with crunchy spiced flakes and fried to shattering perfection, filled with molten cheese. Ahmedabad's favourite crunch!

menuItems.name: Crispy Kurkure Veg Momo
menuItems.description: Crunchy crumb coated momos dusted with fiery Himalayan peri-peri seasoning. Served with mint dip and garlic chilli chutney.

menuItems.name: Melted Cheese Corn Momo
menuItems.description: Sweet American golden corn blended with melted mozzarella and cheddar cheese with mild Italian seasoning. Cheesy delight in every bite.

menuItems.name: Cheese Burst Momo Special
menuItems.description: Steamed and grilled dumplings infused with double cheese core that oozes creamy warmth. Served with garlic dip.

menuItems.name: Fiery Chilli Veg Momo
menuItems.description: Crispy fried momos wok-tossed with red and green bell peppers, diced onions, garlic and dark soy glaze. Spicy and bold.

menuItems.name: Schezwan Chilli Paneer Momo
menuItems.description: Tender paneer momos tossed in chef's special homemade Himalayan Schezwan sauce, garnished with toasted sesame and green scallions.

menuItems.name: Hakka Street Veg Noodles
menuItems.description: Wok-seared thin noodles tossed with crunchy cabbage, julienned carrots, capsicum and light garlic soy seasoning.

menuItems.name: Spicy Schezwan Garlic Noodles
menuItems.description: Fiery wok-tossed noodles with crushed red chillies, burned garlic and fresh vegetables for bold Asian kick.

menuItems.name: Traditional Himalayan Thukpa
menuItems.description: Authentic Tibetan comfort noodle soup simmered with ginger, garlic, cilantro, aromatic mountain spices and hearty veggies.

menuItems.name: Hot & Sour Vegetable Soup
menuItems.description: Classic tangy and peppery warming broth loaded with finely chopped mushrooms, bamboo shoots and shredded vegetables.

menuItems.name: Mountain Mint Iced Cooler
menuItems.description: Freshly muddled garden mint, zesty lemon, Himalayan rock salt and chilled soda. The ultimate palate refresher.

menuItems.name: Spiced Himalayan Masala Chaas
menuItems.description: Traditional churned curd whipped with roasted cumin seeds, green chillies, ginger and mountain black salt.

reviews.review: Hands down the best Kurkure momos in Ahmedabad! The crunch is unmatched and the chutney has that authentic mountain punch. A must-visit in Bapunagar!
The Himalayan Jhol momos reminded me of my trip to Kathmandu. The warm sesame soup broth is heavenly, especially on chilly evenings. Outstanding quality and so hygienic.
Below Sankalp in Bapunagar - such an amazing hidden gem! Cheese burst momos are incredible. Fast service, very hygienic packaging and friendly staff.
Clean ambience, reasonable pricing under ₹150, and authentic bold flavours. The chilli paneer momos had the perfect wok char! 5 stars easily.
Loved the Thukpa soup and Steamed Paneer Momos. Very fresh dough and hot dipping sauce. Great value for money.
Visited yesterday with family. Tried 4 varieties and all were top notch. Waiting to come back for the Jhol momos!
